markets.question: Will Remo Stars win their next NPFL match?
markets.yes_if: Remo Stars are declared winners of their next scheduled NPFL league match after 90 minutes plus stoppage time.
markets.no_if: Remo Stars draw or lose their next scheduled NPFL league match, as shown in the official NPFL result.
markets.edge_cases: If the match is postponed past the close time or abandoned without a result, the market is voided.

markets.question: Will Super Eagles score two or more goals in their next match?
markets.yes_if: Nigeria's senior men's team scores two or more goals in regulation time of their next official match.
markets.no_if: Nigeria scores fewer than two goals in regulation time of their next official match.
markets.edge_cases: Extra time and penalty shootouts do not count. A match not played before close voids the market.

markets.question: Will a Nigerian song top the Apple Music Nigeria chart this Friday?
markets.yes_if: The number one song on the Apple Music Top 100: Nigeria chart on Friday at 12:00 WAT is by a Nigerian lead artist.
markets.no_if: The number one song on that chart at that time is by a lead artist who is not Nigerian.
markets.edge_cases: Featured artists do not count; only the lead credited artist. If the chart is unavailable, it is voided.

markets.question: Will Lagos record rainfall on Saturday?
markets.yes_if: NiMet or a major weather service reports measurable rainfall (0.1 mm or more) in Lagos on Saturday, WAT.
markets.no_if: No measurable rainfall is reported for Lagos on Saturday, WAT, by those sources.
markets.edge_cases: Rain anywhere in Lagos State counts. If no source reports by resolve time, the market is voided.

markets.question: Will a Nigerian startup announce a funding round of $10M or more this week?
markets.yes_if: A Nigeria-headquartered startup publicly announces a single equity or debt round of at least US$10 million before close.
markets.no_if: No such announcement is made by a Nigeria-headquartered startup before the market closes.
markets.edge_cases: Acquisitions and grants do not count. Announcements are judged by the date of first public report.

markets.question: Will a Nollywood film be the top Netflix Nigeria movie on Sunday?
markets.yes_if: The number one film on Netflix's Top 10 Movies in Nigeria list on Sunday is a Nigerian production.
markets.no_if: The number one film on that list on Sunday is not a Nigerian production.
markets.edge_cases: Series do not count. If the Top 10 list is not published for Sunday, the market is voided.
